name: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells construction machineries in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Russia, CIS, Africa, the Middle East, the Asia-Pacific, and China. The company operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Business and Specialized Parts and Service Business. It offers excavators and wheel loaders, hydraulic excavators, compaction equipment, and rigid dump trucks.
